title: Thai Irish Stew
description: A fusion twist on a classic stew, blending the bold flavors of Thai cuisine with tender Irish lamb. Serve warm and enjoy!
instructions: In a large Dutch oven, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat.
Add the lamb and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the curry paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the coconut milk, potatoes, onion, and garlic. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Stir in the fish sauce and brown sugar. Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve the stew warm, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
